title: Alumis crushed by midstage lupus flop but plots path to phase 3 for TYK2 inhibitor

title: Loss of cGAS disrupts H3K9me3 organization and derepresses LINE1 to cause inflammaging
summary: Nature Aging, Published online: 26 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s43587-026-01217-9 Age-associated inflammation, also known as inflammaging, has been associated with cGAS–STING signaling, and this pathway has been proposed as a potential therapeutic target. Unexpectedly, we find that cGAS knockout mice have a shortened median lifespan and healthspan. cGAS-deficient cells show increased activity of long interspersed nuclear element 1 (LINE1) elements and disorganization of the landscape of histone 3 methylation on lysine 9 (H3K9me3).
